pad_rule: Concatenate pads in order. Each pad is the bytes of prefix_hex, then byte repeated count times, then the bytes of suffix_hex. byte is an integer from 0 to 255. prefix_hex and suffix_hex are lowercase hex and may be empty. The Rust test expands pads the same way to build the raw result, then compares the extractor output to text_hex when that field is present. When the output is longer than 256 bytes, compare its byte length to text_len and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its bytes to text_sha256. The output is raw bytes and may be invalid UTF-8.
